_comment: Everything from aux-only, aux-boot and alien-piano-riff in ONE package. The updater looks for exactly one SMEG_PLUS_UPG at the stick root, so three side-by-side packages would not all be found - combining is the only way to have all three at once. NOT a tested combination on hardware.

_pairs.aux-autoswitch: supersedes aux-always-available, which patches only IsAUXSRCAvailable; this also removes the GetMediaDevice bail-out
_pairs.aux-boot-default: C_MGR_SRC::StartUp restores AUX (position 7) on every boot, ignoring Last_Source
_pairs.spy-dump-userdata-partition: from alien-piano-riff; a different address, no overlap with the AUX sites

_beacon: gui_ver 32.01 is the visible did-it-apply signal, and ring1 renamed to Piano_riff
_settings: No USER_DATA payload, so the car's own settings - paired phones, destinations, presets - are NOT touched.
